reported_fitted_or_used.name: Spindle gearbox PLC interface
reported_fitted_or_used.source_line: The spindle gearbox has two stages. The owner reports that its gear-change program runs separately in the PLC and the PLC signals LinuxCNC when the gearbox is ready. At the time of the post, the owner said the gearbox could still be troublesome because of its solenoid valves and mechanical gears. The owner also says a forum-linked video shows the mill cutting under load, with the demonstration described as a test.
